## Act 1

<figure class="story-hero"><a href="/forge-studio/media/stories/S10/01-open-the-project-forge-already-manages.png"><img src="/forge-studio/media/stories/S10/01-open-the-project-forge-already-manages.png" alt="1. Open the project forge already manages"></a></figure>

1. Open the project forge already manages
2. Press "Architect →"
3. Describe the work, cap what this run may spend, and press "Start architect"
4. Open the session and answer the Architect's questions
5. Read the plan at the gate and approve it
6. Go back to the project the plan belongs to
7. Go to the roadmap, where the approved plan is already being worked
8. Watch the factory plan and build the initiative
9. Open the initiative to find the run it produced
10. Hand the plan to the build flow
11. Open the flows index to watch the build
12. Open the develop flow monitor
13. Wait for the build flow to claim the run
14. Pull the emergency halt while the run builds
15. The active run finishes under the halt
16. Release the halt
17. Watch the run build
18. The built work is assembled for review
19. The review station finishes its pass
20. The review findings are on the run page
21. Open the review verdict at its gate
22. Anchor one blocking comment to the precedence criterion (the first criterion, said so in the log, when none names precedence) and send it back
23. The fix lands on the same branch and comes back for re-review
24. Open the re-reviewed verdict at its gate
25. Read the fix against the criterion, and resolve the blocking comment it answers (the first criterion's, said so in the log, when none names precedence)
26. Approve — which is the merge
27. Reflect on the cycle
28. Open the knowledge graph
29. Find what the cycle learned on the knowledge graph
30. Open the flows index
31. Check what the run cost

## Act 2

<figure class="story-hero"><a href="/forge-studio/media/stories/S10/32-act-2-open-the-projects-index-to-start-a.png"><img src="/forge-studio/media/stories/S10/32-act-2-open-the-projects-index-to-start-a.png" alt="32. Open the projects index to start a second initiative"></a></figure>

32. Open the projects index to start a second initiative
33. Open gitpulse again
34. Press "Architect →" for the second idea
35. Describe the second idea and start its architect
36. Open the session and answer the second interview
37. Read the second plan at the gate and approve it
38. Go back to the project for the second initiative
39. Return to the roadmap, where the second plan is already being worked
40. Watch the factory plan and build the second initiative
41. Open the second initiative to find the run it produced
42. Hand the second plan to the build flow
43. Open the flows index to watch the second run build
44. Open the develop flow monitor
45. Wait for the second run's first work item to start
46. Open the second run's own detail page
47. Stop the second run mid-flight
48. Step away while the stop lands
49. After the stop, the running work item finished naturally
50. And the next work item never started at all
51. Open the second run's own detail page again
52. Confirm the stopped, resumable state
53. Pull the emergency halt before resuming
54. Resume via the run's own resume control
55. Step back to the monitor before reading the queued run
56. Open the resumed run's detail page
57. The resumed run waits queued while the halt is on
58. Release the halt so the resumed run can start
59. Step back to the monitor to watch the resumed run
60. The finished work item survived the stop and the resume
61. The unfinished work item resumes, not skipped
